caption: The drawing depicts a single spur with a brown leather strap and a large brass buckle. The spur itself is metallic, featuring a dark finish with silver decorative inlays and a rowel (the spiked wheel) at one end, which is dark in color with multiple points. The leather strap is looped through the spur and includes a round silver button. The objects are centrally positioned on a plain, off-white or cream-colored background, with no additional items or scenery visible. The overall composition is simple and focused, with the spur and strap lying horizontally and casting no visible shadow.
title: Spur
